verdict.rationale: Morph documents a first-party Batch component that runs thousands of chat completions offline at half price, which is a genuine bulk-operation capability for an API product. The evidence is a single one-line claim, so how far it goes is unproven. Missing for 10: details on batch job submission format, status/polling and result retrieval, which endpoints or tools (e.g. Fast Apply, Reflexes, Compact) support batching, limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
